items.question: Which lunar mansions and weekday qualify as auspicious occasions for the prescribed rite?
premises: Pūrvabhādrapadā in conjunction is named as a suitable timing.
The lunar mansion Svātī is named as a suitable timing.
Tuesday is named as the suitable weekday.
items.inference: These astrological conditions constitute additional valid occasions for the prescribed action.
uncertainties: The exact astrological sense of yoge with pūrvabhādrapadā depends on broader ritual context.
items.plain_english: Or when Pūrvabhādrapadā is in conjunction, or in Svātī, on a Tuesday.
